Legacy DWD RData filenames

legacy_dwd_rdata_filenames.Rd

These exported constants are retained for compatibility with workflows from an earlier development stage that stored complete downloads as RData files. New code should use dwd_fst_filename() for the current FST-based workflow.

Usage

HistoricalDWD

HistoricalDWDRain

fn_HistoricalDWD

fn_HistoricalDWDRain

Format

A character scalar containing a legacy RData filename.

An object of class character of length 1.

An object of class character of length 1.

An object of class character of length 1.

An object of class character of length 1.

Deprecated

These RData filename constants are deprecated and must not be repurposed as FST filenames. They remain exported only for backward compatibility.
